label: End of episode (trials 95-99), after two a1 trials in a row that both went rare to S2; fires at D1/GO
explanation: A very sparse feature (0.02% of steps). On dev, every activation falls in episode trials 90-99, where the value head is low (all of them in the lowest value bin, under 5.2). Activations come only at D1 and GO, never at D2. 97% of mass comes when the previous trial was a1 with a rare transition to S2. Strongest activations come at the next D1 after two consecutive a1 trials that both went rare to S2, especially when the D1 reward input is 1, and often just before the agent switches to a2. The agent mostly believes S1 is good (low_first episodes). The simple predicate (D1/GO, previous trial a1 rare, ep_trial>=90) reaches 97% recall but only 3.5% precision. Requiring two consecutive a1-rare trials and ep_trial>=95 lifts dev precision to 0.29 (F1 0.38, mass recall 0.71). That is the predicate recorded. It uses only observed history plus episode time, no future variables. Much of the late-episode a1-rare context still does not activate it, so the description is incomplete.
